name: New Era
verdict: Family-owned US headwear company, run by fourth-generation CEO Chris Koch (no relation to Koch Industries). Nothing found.
note: Official Cap of LIV Golf; appears on every team page including Korean Golf Club (livgolf.com/korean-golf-club, fetched 2026-10-03). Checked 2026-10-03: the only human-rights episode found is a 2008 Workers Rights Consortium/CWA campaign over safety and union-busting allegations at New Era's Derby, NY plant - charges and a campaign, not a court, regulator or NGO finding, and WRC later hailed improvements; no qualifying finding found.
